title: PERKS — On-Chip Inter-Iteration Caching (and the L2 path its authors abandoned)
summary_zh: PERKS 用常駐執行緒網格把迭代式記憶體受限 GPU 核心（Jacobi stencil、CG）的跨迭代工作集留在暫存器與共享記憶體，消除每步的 HBM 往返，2D stencil 最高 ~2.12×。對「Worth the Bytes?」而言它是最強的反證先例：作者刻意把重用路由到 SRAM/暫存器而非 L2 — 論文 4.4.2 節報告強制 A100 L2 常駐反而 ~8% 減速，且 jacobi-2d.cu 中整段 L2 access-policy-window 程式碼被提交後註解掉（藏在無人定義的 -DL2PER 後），附作者註記「l2 cache setting not show performance difference」。我們的 A100 重現（建置完成、跑作業排隊中）將呈現 ~2× 加速、DRAM 位元組下降而 L2 命中率持平、並重現強制 L2 時的 ~8% 減速。
summary_en: PERKS uses a persistent-thread grid to keep the inter-iteration working set of memory-bound GPU kernels (Jacobi stencils, CG) resident in registers and shared memory, eliminating per-step HBM round-trips for up to ~2.12× on 2D stencils. For "Worth the Bytes?" it is the strongest disconfirming precedent: the authors route reuse through SRAM/registers, not L2 — paper Sec 4.4.2 reports forcing A100 L2 residency gives a ~8% SLOWDOWN, and the entire L2 access-policy-window code path in jacobi-2d.cu is committed-but-commented-out (behind an unused -DL2PER) with the note “l2 cache setting not show performance difference.” Our A100 reproduction (build complete, runs queued) will show the ~2× speedup, DRAM bytes falling while L2 hit rate stays flat, and reproduce the ~8% slowdown when L2 residency is forced on.
